spans.s:
śréyāṃs, a. fairer; more beautiful or
excellent; better; as n. (the better, i. e.)
welfare, prosperity, 35^1. [from an unused
root śrī corresponding to the noun
śrī́, 470^4: cf. κρείων, ‘superior, ruler.’]

śréṣṭha, a. fairest; most excellent;
best: w. gen., 1^10; w. loc., 58^10; at end
of cpd, 11^9; best as distinguished from
(abl.), equiv. to better than, 68^14. [see
śreyāṃs.]
